onepager: 73. Procurement and Supplier Collaboration Agent one-pager.pptx
note: Locked synthetic persona-language case per exposed operation, one per story turn. Prompts avoid operation names and preserve the award, order, supplier message and payment approval boundary.

cases.onepager_bullet: Turns demand from the maintenance plan, capital projects and stock replenishment into requisitions with the right procurement route and an eligible supplier shortlist
cases.prompt: What requisitions are waiting, how should we buy each one, and who should we invite for the transformer order?

cases.onepager_bullet: Drafts answers to supplier questions from the published RFQ pack, and routes anything new to a clarification every bidder sees
cases.prompt: A bidder on the transformer RFQ asks if they can deliver all 24 units in two lots instead of three. What should I tell them?

arguments.question: Can we deliver all 24 units in two lots instead of three?

cases.onepager_bullet: Scores every bid on price, lead time, quality and sustainability and explains the ranked recommendation for the award panel
cases.prompt: The transformer bids are in. How do they score, and who should the award panel pick?

cases.onepager_bullet: Flags unacknowledged purchase orders and shipping notices that miss the committed delivery date, with the project they put at risk
cases.prompt: Which of our open orders have delivery problems I need to chase today?

cases.onepager_bullet: Runs the three-way match of purchase order, goods receipt and invoice, and holds the exceptions with the amount in question
cases.prompt: Which supplier invoices can go for payment approval today, and which ones need to be held?
